items.description: When Ge Yixiao stepped out of her car at Ngari Dark Sky Park, the Milky Way stretched across the night sky above her — a sight she had never witnessed before.

items.title: Step into the wonderful world of the CIIE
items.description: The China International Import Expo is far more than an expo for imported goods, it's also a launchpad for cutting-edge technologies from global firms, a debut platform for new exhibitors stepping into the Chinese market, and a grand gathering bringing together 162 countries, regions and international organizations. As the 9th China International Import Expo kicks off, this two-minute video offers you a fresh look at the CIIE.

items.title: Your AI works remotely
items.description: You tap “generate.” Where does the computing happen — and what powers it? China is connecting AI demand in its eastern cities with data centers and renewable energy in the west. Your next AI creation may start far from your screen.

items.title: Course charted for strict Party self-governance
items.description: As China enters a critical period in its modernization drive, the governing Communist Party of China has charted the course for tougher action against corruption and stronger self-governance in the years ahead.

items.title: AllianzGI sees growing A-share appeal
items.description: Allianz Global Investors has turned overweight on Chinese equities, driven by strong corporate earnings, a growing need for portfolio diversification, and investment opportunities ranging from artificial intelligence and robotics to energy storage and biomedical innovation, a senior executive said.

items.title: Draft amendment to Criminal Procedure Law boosts legal aid
items.description: China is seeking to refine its criminal case procedures through amendments to the Criminal Procedure Law, aiming to strengthen efforts to combat crime while providing greater protection for human rights amid growing public expectations for justice and security.

items.title: Mainland reaffirms Taiwan's ineligibility for Interpol membership
items.description: Zhu Fenglian, spokesperson for the State Council Taiwan Affairs Office, made the remarks in response to Taiwan's Democratic Progressive Party authorities, which claimed that the island's exclusion from Interpol had created a gap in global security and called for international support for its membership.

items.title: Railway expands parcel services for Singles' Day rush
items.description: China's railway authorities launched a 20-day express delivery operation on Sunday to handle the Singles' Day online shopping rush, with high-speed rail express capacity expected to increase 10 percent year-on-year, according to China Railway Express.

items.title: Five experts awarded for innovation in education research

items.title: Agri science key climate change tool, say experts
items.description: Agricultural science and technology is expected to play a greater role in international cooperation as countries face mounting pressures from climate change, resource constraints and disruptions to food supply chains, experts said on Monday at a global forum in Hainan province.

items.title: Chinese fashion brands going global
items.description: For decades, Chinese consumer brands built their success on manufacturing scale, supply-chain efficiency and digital retail. Now, a new generation is building brands that can command attention — and premium prices — overseas.

items.title: China's gold consumption reaches 684.62 metric tons in Jan-Sept
items.description: China's gold consumption edged up 0.28 percent year-on-year to 684.62 metric tons in the first three quarters of 2026, driven by robust investment demand for gold bars and coins as major Chinese mining groups simultaneously expanded overseas production to cushion a domestic supply contraction, the China Gold Association said on Wednesday.

items.title: Hainan 'resort retail' project riding evolving consumption habits
items.description: Swire Properties is betting on the country's growing appetite for destination retail with its first resort-style Taikoo Li development on the Chinese mainland, as shopping centers increasingly evolve into leisure destinations encouraging extended stays rather than places to simply fill up shopping carts.

items.title: Use of AI to expand across industries
items.description: China will deepen its "AI Plus" initiative during the 15th Five-Year Plan period (2026-30), expanding the use of artificial intelligence across industries to foster new drivers of economic growth, officials with the National Development and Reform Commission said at a news conference in Beijing on Tuesday.

items.title: Short-form dramas growing fast
items.description: ByteDance's short-drama app Hongguo has overtaken its fast-growing artificial intelligence assistant Doubao in user numbers, underscoring how short-form dramas are emerging as one of the strongest drivers of engagement in China's increasingly saturated mobile internet market.

items.title: Steel sector shifts to high-quality development amid market headwinds
items.description: China's steel industry is accelerating its shift from volume-driven expansion toward higher-quality, more efficient growth, as changing demand and rising costs drive steelmakers to optimize capacity and product mixes and develop higher-value-added products to support sustainable development, industry insiders said.
